module.purpose: Encapsulates subscription logic for connecting a component to a redux store and nesting subscriptions of descendant components so ancestors re-render before descendants.
module.summary: This module provides a factory for creating subscription objects that manage a linked list of listeners and support nested subscriptions. It uses reference counting to keep a store subscription alive while any nested or self subscriptions exist, and ensures parent components update before child components by wiring nested subscriptions through the parent's change handler.
module.businessContext: Part of react-redux binding layer. Critical for correct re-render ordering and avoiding stale props in nested connected components.
classes: Listener (~L9-13): Linked-list node holding callback and prev/next references
Subscription (~L81-90): Interface describing subscription object with nested sub methods
functions: createListenerCollection (~L15-77): Returns object managing listener linked list with clear/notify/get/subscribe
createSubscription (~L97-183): Creates subscription managing nested and self lifecycle with refcount

detail.name: createListenerCollection
postconditions: Returns a new object with clear, notify, get, and subscribe methods
Initially contains no listeners (first and last pointers are null)
invariants: Listeners are stored in a doubly-linked list maintained by first and last pointers
Subscribed listeners remain in the list until explicitly unsubscribed or cleared
edgeCases: When no listeners are subscribed, notify() triggers no callbacks
Subscribing and immediately unsubscribing removes the listener from the list
When the collection is cleared, all listeners are removed (first and last set to null)
stateMutations: Initializes first and last variables to null
detail.summary: Factory function creating a listener collection that supports subscribing and unsubscribing callbacks, notifying all listeners within a batched context, and retrieving the current list of listeners.

specTests.then: the callback's function is executed exactly once within a batched context

units.name: notify

detail.name: notify
postconditions: All currently registered listeners have their callback invoked exactly once during this call
invariants: Listeners are traversed via the linked-list formed by listener.next pointers starting from the collection's first listener
edgeCases: No listeners registered: the while loop body is never entered and batch completes without invoking any callback
detail.summary: Iterates over every registered listener in insertion order and synchronously invokes each listener's callback within a single batched update, ensuring all subscribed listeners are notified together.

Each listener appears exactly once in the result.
edgeCases: When the collection is empty, returns an empty array.
detail.summary: Returns a snapshot array of all listeners in the collection, in insertion order, without mutating internal state.

units.name: subscribe

detail.name: subscribe
preconditions: The enclosing createListenerCollection instance must not have been finalized/destroyed.
callback must be a callable function.
postconditions: On return, the callback is linked as the new tail node of the listener list.
The returned unsubscribe function, when invoked, removes the listener node from the list if still subscribed.
Subsequent invocations of the unsubscribe closure are idempotent and perform no further mutation.
invariants: Each listener node has exactly callback, next, prev fields with next/prev forming a doubly-linked structure.
A given listener is unlinked from the list at most once.
After unlinking, isSubscribed guard prevents double-removal side effects.
edgeCases: Empty list: when 'last' is null prior to insertion, the new listener becomes both the head (first) and tail (last).
Single-node list: unsubscribe of the only node resets first and last to null.
Middle-node removal: adjacent nodes' next/prev pointers are reconnected.
Tail removal: the predecessor becomes the new tail.
Head removal: the successor becomes the new head.
Calling unsubscribe more than once: the isSubscribed guard short-circuits after the first call.
stateMutations: Mutates the enclosing collection's 'first' and 'last' tail pointers.
Mutates neighboring listener nodes' next/prev pointers.
Closes over local 'isSubscribed' flag captured by the returned unsubscribe closure.
detail.summary: Registers a callback in a doubly-linked listener list and returns a closure that, when called, unlinks the callback from the list exactly once.

detail.name: createSubscription
detail.signature: export function createSubscription(store: any, parentSub?: Subscription)
preconditions: If parentSub is omitted, store must provide a subscribe(listener) method returning an unsubscribe function
If parentSub is provided, it must expose an addNestedSub(listener) method returning a cleanup function
postconditions: Returns a Subscription object with addNestedSub, notifyNestedSubs, handleChangeWrapper, isSubscribed, trySubscribe, tryUnsubscribe, and getListeners methods
Initial state has isSubscribed() returning false and getListeners() returning nullListeners
The returned subscription's handleChangeWrapper will invoke subscription.onStateChange (if set) when the store or parent emits a change
invariants: subscriptionsAmount is always non-negative and tracks active nested + self subscriptions
unsubscribe is set only once (lazily on first subscription); store.subscribe or parentSub.addNestedSub is called at most once per createSubscription instance
When unsubscribe is defined, listeners is a live ListenerCollection (not nullListeners)
When unsubscribe is undefined, listeners is nullListeners
Cleanup functions returned by addNestedSub are idempotent (removed flag guards re-entry)
edgeCases: parentSub omitted: subscribes directly to store.subscribe
parentSub provided: subscribes through parentSub.addNestedSub
subscriptionsAmount reaches 0: unsubscribe is called, listeners cleared, listeners reset to nullListeners
addNestedSub cleanup called multiple times: only first call performs cleanup (removed flag)
trySubscribeSelf called when already selfSubscribed: no-op (selfSubscribed guard)
tryUnsubscribeSelf called when not selfSubscribed: no-op (selfSubscribed guard)
stateMutations: unsubscribe (closure variable, holds store or parent subscription cleanup function)
detail.summary: Factory that creates a Subscription object with reference-counted nested listener management, lazily subscribing to either a parent subscription or a store and cleaning up resources when all references are removed.

units.name: addNestedSub

detail.name: addNestedSub
preconditions: The outer subscription (via trySubscribe) must be available and not blocked when called.
postconditions: The provided listener is registered with the listeners collection.
The returned function, when invoked, unsubscribes the listener exactly once and triggers tryUnsubscribe.
invariants: The returned cleanup function is idempotent.
cleanupListener is called at most once.
tryUnsubscribe is invoked at most once after a successful trySubscribe.
edgeCases: Calling the returned function multiple times only performs cleanup and tryUnsubscribe on the first invocation; subsequent calls are no-ops.
If trySubscribe is called and no prior subscription exists, it establishes the outer subscription before adding the nested listener.
stateMutations: Subscribes to the outer subscription via trySubscribe.
Adds listener to the local listeners collection.
The returned function removes the listener and calls tryUnsubscribe.
detail.summary: Registers a nested listener via trySubscribe and listeners.subscribe, returning a guarded unsubscribe function that invokes cleanup once.

detail.name: notifyNestedSubs
postconditions: Every active listener registered on the internal listeners collection has its notify callback invoked.
stateMutations: calls listeners.notify() which may iterate over listener collection
detail.summary: Notifies all registered nested subscribers by delegating to the internal listeners collection's notify method, triggering their callbacks with no arguments.

detail.name: handleChangeWrapper
preconditions: The enclosing subscription object must exist and expose an onStateChange property.
postconditions: If subscription.onStateChange is truthy, it has been invoked exactly once with no arguments. If falsy, no action is taken and no exception is thrown.
invariants: subscription.onStateChange is only invoked when it is truthy.
edgeCases: subscription.onStateChange is undefined or null — function returns without invoking anything and without throwing.
detail.summary: Guards the optional onStateChange callback of the enclosing subscription and invokes it when present, ensuring no runtime error occurs if the callback is unset.

detail.name: isSubscribed
preconditions: None. The function reads only from the closed-over `selfSubscribed` variable.
postconditions: Returns the current value of `selfSubscribed` as a boolean.
invariants: `selfSubscribed` is only ever mutated via `trySubscribeSelf` and `tryUnsubscribeSelf`, preserving a consistent boolean subscription state.
edgeCases: When `selfSubscribed` is `true`, returns `true`.
When `selfSubscribed` is `false`, returns `false`.
detail.summary: Returns whether the subscription is currently self-subscribed, exposing the internal subscription state to callers without requiring them to manage it directly.

units.name: trySubscribe

detail.name: trySubscribe
preconditions: store exposes a subscribe(handleChangeWrapper) method when parentSub is absent
parentSub exposes an addNestedSub(handleChangeWrapper) method when present
handleChangeWrapper is a defined callback reference
subscriptionsAmount, unsubscribe, listeners, parentSub, and store are bound closure variables
postconditions: subscriptionsAmount is incremented by exactly 1 on every call
On the first call (unsubscribe was falsy), unsubscribe is assigned the result of parentSub.addNestedSub(handleChangeWrapper) (nested) or store.subscribe(handleChangeWrapper) (standalone)
On the first call, listeners is (re)initialised via createListenerCollection()
On subsequent calls (unsubscribe already truthy), no re-subscription occurs and listeners is not re-initialised
invariants: subscriptionsAmount is monotonically non-decreasing
unsubscribe, once assigned a truthy value, is never cleared by trySubscribe on subsequent calls
edgeCases: unsubscribe is falsy and parentSub is absent: calls store.subscribe(handleChangeWrapper), assigns result to unsubscribe, creates listeners collection
unsubscribe is falsy and parentSub is present: calls parentSub.addNestedSub(handleChangeWrapper) instead of store.subscribe, assigns result to unsubscribe, creates listeners collection
unsubscribe is already truthy (second or later call): only increments subscriptionsAmount; skips subscribe/addNestedSub and listener collection creation
detail.summary: Registers this subscription with its parent (if nested) or the external store, incrementing the subscription count and initialising the listener collection exactly once on the first subscribe.

units.name: tryUnsubscribe

detail.name: tryUnsubscribe
preconditions: The subscription must have been initialized (i.e., trySubscribe was previously called at least once so that subscriptionsAmount reflects active subscriptions).
postconditions: On exit, subscriptionsAmount is reduced by exactly 1. If subscriptionsAmount reaches 0, the unsubscribe handle is invoked, set to undefined, listeners.clear() is called, and listeners is reassigned to nullListeners.
invariants: subscriptionsAmount is never incremented or decremented inconsistently within a single call. listeners is either a populated ListenerCollection or the shared nullListeners placeholder, never null after reassignment.
edgeCases: If unsubscribe is undefined or null at entry, the conditional branch is skipped and only the subscription count decrement occurs. If subscriptionsAmount does not reach zero after decrementing, the unsubscribe handle is not invoked and listeners are preserved.
detail.summary: Decrements the active subscription count and, when it reaches zero, tears down the underlying unsubscribe handle and clears all registered listeners.

units.name: trySubscribeSelf

detail.name: trySubscribeSelf
postconditions: Once this function returns, selfSubscribed is true and trySubscribe has been called exactly once for this subscription instance.
invariants: selfSubscribed is never reset back to false once set to true within the same subscription lifetime.
edgeCases: Called multiple times: only the first call triggers trySubscribe(); subsequent calls are no-ops.
detail.summary: Guards the self-subscription side-effect of a subscription by ensuring trySubscribe is invoked at most once per subscription lifecycle.

specTests.then: selfSubscribed becomes true and trySubscribe is called exactly once
trySubscribe is not called again and no state changes

units.name: tryUnsubscribeSelf

detail.name: tryUnsubscribeSelf
preconditions: selfSubscribed must be a boolean accessible in closure scope
postconditions: If selfSubscribed was true, it is set to false and tryUnsubscribe is invoked; if selfSubscribed was false, no mutation or call occurs
invariants: selfSubscribed flag accurately reflects whether this instance has self-subscribed
edgeCases: When selfSubscribed is false, the function performs no side effects and does not call tryUnsubscribe; when selfSubscribed is true, tryUnsubscribe is called exactly once
stateMutations: selfSubscribed (set to false when previously true)
detail.summary: Guards self-unsubscription by clearing the selfSubscribed flag and delegating to tryUnsubscribe only when this instance previously subscribed itself.

specTests.then: selfSubscribed becomes false and tryUnsubscribe is invoked once
selfSubscribed remains false and tryUnsubscribe is never called
